task: Prepare a US large-cap momentum shortlist for a portfolio manager. Using a captured current S&P 500 roster and prices through the completed 2026-10-16 session, retain stocks above their 200-session moving average and rank by their 12-minus-1-month price momentum. Return up to 20 names with sector, three-month return and 20-session average daily dollar volume, plus a table showing coverage and exclusions. Return tables only.
context: Persona: a US equities desk. Use real observations available through configured Epoch data sources. This is an analysis request, not an order to trade.

Calculate numerical results in the saved study, inspect the actual execution evidence, and publish exactly the requested named outputs. Tables must reference saved computed relations and fields; do not enumerate or invent market observations.

Preserve actual source, coverage, fiscal/calendar basis, corporate-action policy and retrieval time. If required data or a capability is unavailable, report the concrete gap; do not substitute another security, source definition, period or model assumption.
The published answer is the response. Do not repeat it in a separate assistant narrative or create a matching dashboard table merely because a table response was requested.

Use the current S&P 500 constituent snapshot discovered for this run and record its actual retrieval timestamp. This is a present-universe desk screen using a fixed price cutoff, not a historical index backtest or a point-in-time membership claim.

Price cutoff is 2026-10-16, the latest completed US session when this case was prepared. Keep it fixed for reproducibility; changing the cutoff or refreshing membership intentionally requires a new research operation ID.

Use configured vendor-native daily data and preserve its actual definition. Do not claim independently verified regular-session or auction prints when the metadata does not establish that basis. Momentum is C(t-21)/C(t-252)-1 and three-month return is C(t)/C(t-63)-1 on split-adjusted closes; these are price returns. The SMA is the trailing 200-session mean including t. No future prices may enter the screen.

Only eligible names enter the ranking. Sort momentum descending, break exact ties by ticker ascending, and assign contiguous ranks. Return min(20, eligible_count), without duplicate tickers or invented replacement names.

Load the complete captured roster, rather than silently screening only a truncated subset. Record coverage counts and missing-data exclusions. Use actual traded-dollar volume with consistent price/share split units; do not multiply a dividend-adjusted close by raw historical volume.
Persist company/sector labels, rank, metrics and the coverage row in the saved native results so an output-only JSON follow-up can use the exact same evidence without a new universe lookup.

outputs.name: shortlist
outputs.description: Ranked current-universe shortlist; one row per ticker, ordered by rank.

schema.name: rank
schema.description: Sequential rank starting at 1; descending momentum with ticker ascending as the tie-break.

schema.name: ticker
schema.description: Unique US-listed constituent ticker; the row label is a security, not a timestamp.

schema.name: company
schema.description: Company display name from the resolved asset metadata.

schema.name: sector
schema.description: Sector label from the resolved asset metadata.

schema.name: as_of
schema.description: Exact completed price session used by the screen: 2026-10-16.

schema.name: momentum_12_1
schema.description: Split-adjusted close 21 sessions ago / split-adjusted close 252 sessions ago - 1.

schema.name: return_3m
schema.description: Split-adjusted close at as_of / close 63 sessions ago - 1; price return.

schema.name: distance_to_sma_200
schema.description: As-of split-adjusted close / its trailing 200-session SMA - 1; strictly positive.

schema.name: average_dollar_volume_20
schema.description: Mean of actual quoted close times traded shares over the last 20 sessions, with price/volume on a consistent split basis.

outputs.name: screening_coverage
outputs.description: Exactly one coverage row for the captured roster and price cutoff.

schema.name: as_of
schema.description: Price observation cutoff fixed for this case: 2026-10-16.

schema.name: membership_snapshot_at
schema.description: Actual retrieval timestamp of the current S&P 500 roster; not a claim of historical membership.

schema.name: universe_count
schema.description: Number of unique constituent tickers in the captured roster.

schema.name: excluded_missing_data_count
schema.description: Constituents excluded for missing required history, fields or metadata.

schema.name: eligible_count
schema.description: Constituents with complete required data and a close strictly above their 200-session SMA.

schema.name: returned_count
schema.description: min(20, eligible_count); do not pad the shortlist with failing names.
